editorial:
Imagine a sunny day at the beach that turns into a total nightmare. You have got a group of volleyball-playing teens who just want to hang out and have a classic slumber party while the parents are gone. The vibe starts off light and silly, with boyfriends trying to play pranks and scare the girls. But there is a creepy stranger lurking in the shadows who is not playing any games. It feels like a typical teen party movie until the body count starts rising and things get chaotic.

What really works here is the mix of goofy comedy and old-school slasher thrills. The acting is pretty campy, which actually adds to the fun because it does not take itself too seriously. While the pacing drags a bit in the middle, the kills are creative and keep you guessing. If you love cheesy 90s horror, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a final showdown between the killer and the last survivors. After a series of chases through the house, the main girl manages to fight back against the masked killer. She uses her surroundings to trap him and eventually kills him, ending the massacre. It is a simple, satisfying finish where the bad guy finally gets what he deserves, leaving the survivors to deal with the aftermath of their wild night.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cheesy 90s horror and slasher flicks.
